scope: Recorded signed-speed/relative-pose samples only. Wall-clock time, absolute location, identifiers, old planned targets and command outputs are omitted. The original simulated timestamp is a simulation counter, not wall-clock time.
counterfactualTestPremises: A completed synthetic curve/route is supplied independently of the historical CurvePending/zero target.
ParkingBrake=true means a newly fresh confirmed parking brake for the counterfactual test; this was not recorded throughout the historical fault window.
ParkingBrake=false is a separate counterfactual using the same recorded speeds/poses and synthetic completed curve.
Pedal receipt/effect feedback is unknown in these counterfactual scenarios, not invented from the old command sequence.
